children: Asset manager Janus Henderson has become a validator on Avalanche, helping secure and operate the network as part of its commitment to tokenized finance and onchain credit. The firm manages roughly $500 billion in assets and anchors capital for an onchain credit platform built on the network.

The move gives Avalanche a concrete institutional-adoption data point. A validator role means Janus Henderson participates directly in securing the chain rather than holding exposure through a product, which strengthens the tokenized finance narrative around AVAX. Investors watching tokenization flows may reposition toward the network as asset managers take operational roles onchain. The mechanism here is participation and story, not a change to token issuance, fees, or supply, so the effect works through adoption perception rather than direct token economics.
